name: _ws2GetJson bypasses the shared gate
why: The wrapper is the whole feature: every retrying /ws/2 request goes through _mbGateFetch(). Back to a bare fetch(), a hold another script wrote no longer delays our click.

                    { background, cancelled, label, onWait });
edits.replace: const resp = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });

name: the write drops fields it does not know
why: Protocol v1: writers keep unknown fields. Writing only the known ones loses a newer writer's field.

name: an unknown version is overwritten
why: Protocol v1: an explicit unknown version is refused without writing. Dropping the refusal rewrites a version-2 schedule as version 1.
